## Validation

List exact commands/results and any environment limitations.

- [ ] Relevant regression tests added or updated.
- [ ] Build, lint, and applicable test suites pass.
- [ ] Documentation and dependency lockfiles updated where needed.
- [ ] No credentials, private payloads, or generated artifacts included.
- [ ] Imported code/assets have identified origins and preserved license notices.
- [ ] No previously applied migration was modified.
